🎬 The Upside (2019) — Comedy / Drama
After a wealthy quadriplegic man named Phillip hires Dell, an unemployed man with a complicated past, to become his caregiver, the two seem completely different at first.
As they spend more time together, their unlikely friendship begins to change both of their lives. Dell helps Phillip experience life with a fresh perspective, while Phillip pushes Dell to become more responsible and reconnect with his family.
The movie explores friendship, family, second chances, personal growth, and finding happiness in unexpected places.
💬 Sometimes the most unexpected person can become the one who changes your life. ❤️
